title: Redesign site for prospective buyers
description: Replace current visual world across all four static routes with the approved Mountain House Monograph direction. Make real photography and verified property evidence primary, route showing requests to realtor@stevenhay.com, and keep planning records secondary but reachable.
design: Comp-led static HTML/CSS redesign. Preserve all verified facts and route navigation. Separate and label planned-work visualisations, retain estimate language, and treat floor/basement drawings as reference or pricing information only. No framework or dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Approved composition is translated across index.html, brochure.html, floorplans.html, and sale-prep.html; primary showing CTAs use realtor@stevenhay.com; real photos lead and planned visuals are labeled; buyer navigation is primary and planning navigation secondary; desktop and 390px mobile have no horizontal overflow; accessibility, structural, detector, comp-diff, and finish-review checks are recorded; PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md match shipped product and visual system.
notes: Approved shape (2026-09-02): prospective buyers first; primary outcome request information/showing; rewrite and condense while preserving verified facts; realtor CTA uses realtor@stevenhay.com; buyer pages primary and planning records secondary; real photography leads, planned-work visualisations appear in a separate visibly labeled section. Selected visual world: The Mountain House Monograph. Decision comp: .impeccable/mocks/decision/model-pick-monograph.png. Concept seed: 16845a6f; selected kind: pick; build path: comp. Supporting decision comps and question log are untracked under .impeccable/. Next required step: start Impeccable build phase for pick, then generate two compositional variations beside selected decision comp and obtain explicit approval before production code. PRODUCT.md currently names owner as primary and must be updated to buyer-first during implementation. Final site must use real authorized photos; existing photo-*.jpg carry Bright MLS watermark.
close_reason: Buyer-first Mountain House Monograph redesign shipped across all four routes; verified photography provenance, planning disclosures, 390px responsiveness, accessibility, 94% comp match, tests, and independent finish review.

title: Implement documented site design
description: Wire DESIGN.md into all four static pages through one shared token-driven stylesheet. Preserve property content, facts, navigation, imagery, and restrained incumbent identity.
design: Add styles.css with documented colors, typography, spacing, square components, responsive behavior, and visible focus. Replace duplicated inline CSS and inline style attributes with shared classes; add viewport metadata.
acceptance_criteria: All HTML pages load styles.css; no page-level style blocks remain; documented tokens and core components are represented; navigation and content remain intact; desktop and mobile render without horizontal overflow; detector and structural checks pass.
close_reason: Implemented shared token-driven stylesheet across four pages; preserved content and imagery; added responsive layouts, contained tables, focus states, image metadata, and passing structural/browser verification.
